finding: Outgoing candidate policy has no matching incoming handoff validation in either component.

code.role: Outgoing filtering removes non-host/globally routable candidates.
Offer bundle.sdp passed unchanged to setRemoteDescription before confirmation.
Answer bundle.sdp passed unchanged after transcript derivation, before confirmation.

safetyAndLimits: Method replaced before invocation and never delegated. No public ICE traffic or file leak tested/observed. Minimal SDP first probe was malformed; strengthened receiver uses browser-generated offer, sender uses actual outgoing offer reshaped as answer plus public candidate. No native acceptance or valid negotiated answer proof.
requirementInterpretation: Original requires internet independence, not explicitly zero internet packets. Existing application outgoing private-host-only policy motivates symmetric inbound hardening; this is a consistency/input-validation finding, not a proven violation of the broader wording or exploitable leak.
proposedHardening: Reject explicit non-host/non-local incoming candidates before creating receiver peer or applying sender answer. Preserve exact accepted SDP for SAS; do not sanitize exchanged transcript. Unit allow/reject/bounds tests and native no-handoff regressions for both roles; normal local pairing/full gates must still pass. Document mDNS and other timing/privacy limits.

standardSource.scope: W3C remoteDescription/ICE candidate model explains why SDP is a connection input; source is not proof of this app sending public traffic.
